entities.name: Willis Whitfield
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Willis Whitfield was an American physicist and inventor of the modern cleanroom, a room with a low level of pollutants used in manufacturing or scientific research. His invention earned him the nickname, "Mr. Clean," from Time Magazine.
